principles: Global common schema and evidence semantics; local engineering, law, standards and cost profiles.
No jurisdictional standard is assumed to be legally adopted from international publication alone.
An approved work item or filed standard is not a published effective requirement.
Unknown local rules, hazards and cost inputs remain explicit and block claims that require them.

standards_register.title: Design criteria of overhead transmission lines
standards_register.scope: Overhead-line design criteria; standard notes that concepts may also inform refurbishment, upgrades and uprating. Does not replace detailed design of supports, foundations, conductors or insulators.
jurisdiction_scope: International reference; national adoption and utility requirements must be checked
standards_register.notes: IEC catalogue identifies edition 4 and stability date 2031. Do not treat this as proof of national adoption.

standards_register.title: Standard for Calculating the Current-Temperature Relationship of Bare Overhead Conductors
standards_register.scope: Numerical relationship between current, conductor temperature and weather; does not prescribe the suitable weather conditions or conductor parameters for a line rating.
jurisdiction_scope: IEEE adopting jurisdictions and projects that specify IEEE 738
standards_register.notes: Active standard, supersedes IEEE 738-2012. Weather and conductor input selection remain a separate engineering responsibility.

standards_register.title: Power cables with extruded insulation and their accessories for rated voltages above 30 kV up to 150 kV
standards_register.scope: Cable systems, cables and accessories for fixed installations in the stated voltage range; special submarine cable systems may require modified or special test conditions.
jurisdiction_scope: International reference; national adoption and utility requirements must be checked
standards_register.notes: The IEC catalogue identifies the 2025 corrigendum and corrected consolidated version.

standards_register.title: Power cables with extruded insulation and their accessories for rated voltages above 150 kV up to 500 kV
standards_register.scope: Cable systems, cables and accessories for fixed installations in the stated voltage range; special submarine systems may require modified or special test conditions.
jurisdiction_scope: International reference; national adoption and utility requirements must be checked
standards_register.notes: The IEC catalogue identifies edition 3 and stability date 2030.

standards_register.title: Insulation co-ordination — Part 2: Application guidelines
standards_register.scope: Application guidance for selection of insulation levels and related withstand requirements; includes detailed simulation and special considerations for cable lines and GIL/GIB.
jurisdiction_scope: International reference; national adoption and utility requirements must be checked
standards_register.known_supersession_or_work_item: IEC 60071-2 Edition 6 is under development; catalogue forecast 2027-12-30.
standards_register.notes: The 2023 edition remains valid in the IEC catalogue snapshot; future work item is not yet a published replacement.

standards_register.title: Insulation co-ordination — Part 11: Definitions, principles and rules for HVDC systems
standards_register.scope: Insulation coordination for HVDC systems, including LCC and VSC; not a human-safety standard.
jurisdiction_scope: International reference; national adoption and utility requirements must be checked
standards_register.notes: A corrigendum from November 2023 is incorporated in the IEC catalogue version.

standards_register.title: Instructions for simulation-based insulation coordination and modelling of electrical networks
standards_register.scope: Guidance for computational modelling and deterministic/probabilistic simulation methods used in insulation coordination studies.
jurisdiction_scope: International technical specification; adoption and utility use must be checked
standards_register.notes: New 2026 technical specification. Particularly relevant to reproducible simulation and uncertainty-aware insulation coordination.

standards_register.title: Hydrogen Piping and Pipelines
standards_register.scope: Hydrogen gaseous mixtures and liquid hydrogen piping/pipelines within stated scope; industrial piping and pipeline requirements are separated.
jurisdiction_scope: United States origin; other jurisdictional use/adoption must be separately checked
standards_register.notes: ASME lists the 2023 edition as remaining in effect. National law or local adoption is not implied.

standards_register.title: Hydrogen fuel quality — Product specification
standards_register.scope: Minimum hydrogen quality characteristics for residential, commercial, industrial, vehicular and stationary uses.
jurisdiction_scope: International reference; national adoption and application must be checked
standards_register.known_supersession_or_work_item: ISO/AWI 14687 Edition 3 approved in June 2026 and under development.
standards_register.notes: Do not treat the future work item as published. The 2025 edition is the published edition in this snapshot.

standards_register.title: Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements
standards_register.scope: Mandatory transmission planning performance requirements within the applicable North American jurisdiction and enforcement framework.
jurisdiction_scope: Applicable NERC jurisdictions only; not a global planning criterion
standards_register.known_supersession_or_work_item: NERC TPL-001-6 is listed as filed and pending regulatory approval in the 2026-11-18 catalogue snapshot.
standards_register.notes: The NERC catalogue distinguishes TPL-001-5.1 mandatory from TPL-001-6 filed/pending approval.

standards_register.designation: CEA Manual on Transmission Planning Criteria 2023
standards_register.title: Manual on Transmission Planning Criteria
standards_register.scope: Transmission planning criteria for the Indian power system. Includes criteria for considering HVDC bipoles in high-capacity long-distance corridors.
standards_register.notes: India-specific planning manual, not a universal HVDC break-even threshold.

standards_register.title: Electric cables — Calculation of the current rating — Part 1-1: Current rating equations (100% load factor) and calculation of losses — General
standards_register.scope: Steady-state current rating and loss calculations for cables at AC voltages and DC voltages up to 5 kV, including buried, duct, trough, steel pipe and aerial installations. Site-specific thermal resistivity and ambient conditions remain input assumptions.
jurisdiction_scope: International reference; national adoption and utility requirements must be checked
standards_register.known_supersession_or_work_item: Included in IEC 60287:2026 SER; series collection is not itself a new technical edition of each included part.
standards_register.notes: IEC catalogue lists edition 3 and stability date 2030. The formulae leave important site and manufacturer/user parameters to be selected and evidenced.

standards_register.title: Electric cables — Calculation of the current rating — Part 2-3: Thermal resistance — Cables installed in ventilated tunnels
standards_register.scope: Continuous current rating factor for cables in naturally or forcibly ventilated tunnels. Published method assumes identical cables, unchanged tunnel cross-section along the route, and negligible longitudinal heat transfer in cables and tunnel surroundings.
jurisdiction_scope: International reference; national adoption and utility requirements must be checked
standards_register.notes: Tunnel thermal boundary assumptions must be checked against actual geometry, ventilation, cable arrangement, heat sources and longitudinal effects; do not extrapolate beyond the stated model assumptions.
